basics.name: Zexin Liu
basics.label: Medical AI and Wearable Health Algorithm Researcher
basics.summary: Advanced algorithm engineer at HONOR with a Ph.D. in Mathematics from the University of Utah. I combine scientific computing, uncertainty quantification, physiological signal modeling, generative modeling, and large-model techniques to build deployable medical and wearable health algorithms.

work.name: HONOR
work.summary: Research and development of medical and health-related algorithms for wearable devices, with emphasis on physiological signal modeling, representation learning, calibration, and product-level robustness.
highlights: Led commercialization of 24-hour continuous non-invasive blood pressure monitoring for the HONOR Watch 5 Pro.
Led commercialization of sudden cardiac arrest screening based on heart-rate deceleration capacity for the HONOR Watch 5 Ultra.
Worked on physiological signal modeling, multimodal representation learning, calibration, domain adaptation, and health-feature algorithm pipelines.
Explored medical large models, fine-tuning, and generative modeling techniques for healthcare-oriented vertical applications.

publications.name: Influence of material parameter variability on the predicted coronary artery biomechanical environment via uncertainty quantification
publications.summary: Applied uncertainty quantification to study how vascular material parameter variability propagates to predicted coronary artery biomechanics.

publications.name: A Stieltjes Algorithm for Generating Multivariate Orthogonal Polynomials
publications.summary: Introduced a Multivariate Stieltjes algorithm for computing recurrence matrices and stable multivariate orthogonal polynomial bases.

publications.name: UncertainSCI: A Python Package for Noninvasive Parametric Uncertainty Quantification of Simulation Pipelines
publications.publisher: The Journal of Open Source Software
publications.summary: Described the UncertainSCI Python package for noninvasive parametric uncertainty quantification of simulation pipelines.

publications.name: UncertainSCI: Uncertainty quantification for computational models in biomedicine and bioengineering
publications.summary: Presented UncertainSCI as a lightweight tool for polynomial-chaos-based uncertainty quantification in biomedical and bioengineering simulations.

publications.name: Using UncertainSCI to Quantify Uncertainty in Cardiac Simulations
publications.summary: Applied UncertainSCI to quantify how heart position and tissue conductivity uncertainty propagate to cardiac simulation outputs.

publications.name: On the Computation of Recurrence Coefficients for Univariate Orthogonal Polynomials
publications.summary: Developed and evaluated algorithms for computing recurrence coefficients for univariate orthogonal polynomial families.
